message: kms:GenerateDataKey is a write-classified action (generates new data encryption keys) included in a declared read-only use case. Only kms:Decrypt and kms:DescribeKey are required for read access. The boundary properly scopes to partner keys, but the action exceeds the stated use case.

kms:GenerateDataKey is a write-classified action in the permission boundary for a declared read-only use case. The boundary allows the created role to use kms:GenerateDataKey if an identity policy grants it. Remove kms:GenerateDataKey from the boundary to enforce the read-only constraint.

Boundary Allow statement 'unnamed' grants cross-account-capable actions (kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey) without aws:ResourceAccount condition. The created role could access resources in other accounts if cross-account resource policies permit it. Add "StringEquals": {"aws:ResourceAccount": "${aws:PrincipalAccount}"} to restrict to same-account.
